basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home in the heart of San Francisco's desirable Richmond District! This beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom single-family residence offers a perfect blend of modern elegance and classic charm. Enjoy an open-concept living and dining area, filled with natural light from large windows. The gourmet kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a spacious island, ideal for gatherings. Retreat to the tranquil primary suite featuring a spa-like en-suite bathroom with a soaking tube and a double vanity. Three additional bedrooms provide ample space for family and guests, while all four bathrooms are tastefully updated with stylish fixtures. Step outside to your private deck overlooking your spacious flat backyard perfect for gardening or unwinding after a long day. Located just a couple blocks from Golden Gate Park and Land's End, trendy cafes, and top-rated schools, this home offers easy access to public transport and major thoroughfares. Bonus features include laundry in the home, ample storage, and a one-car garage. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
